Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODSession

SetInfo

The SetInfo method replaces the info object for this session. 
void SetInfo (in ODInfo info);
info
A reference to the new info object for this session.
DISCUSSION
This method may be called only by a shell plug-in's ODShellPluginInstall function.

SEE ALSO
The ODInfo class (page 346).
The ODShellPluginInstall function (page 952).
